purpose: One development round informed by known baseline failures; same 30 questions, not held-out.
human_review: Original 20 baseline student grades preserved. No human grades on revised answers; all new reviews are AI-generated.
changes: Mandatory initial dense search with eight rather than five results
Narrow evidence-gap wording and preservation of book-specific qualifications
Separate source-support audit before release; one correction then recheck
Bounded transient-error retry with shared tool budget; no daily-quota retries
model_change: Baseline used 3.1-flash-lite, unavailable in saved probe. Revised uses available 3.5-flash-lite; gains cannot be attributed to code alone.
comparison: Same stricter rubric for baseline and revised answers in paired review; rotating A/B order. Judge never sees human grades or baseline verdicts.

orchestration_history.change: Generation concurrency increased from one to two. Answering code, prompts, evidence rules and models unchanged; completed answers retained.

transport_pacing_change.reason: Observed 15 requests/minute provider limit. Added shared 0.2 requests/second pacing. Answer prompts, retrieval, models, validation and correction policy unchanged. Existing outputs retained.

review_orchestration_change.change: Continue past transient paired-review failures, save them and retry only missing reviews on resume. Same model, schema, rubric and prompts. Added hashing of imported runtime files.

final_metadata_update.reason: Updated completion status and descriptions only. Agent model, retrieval design and as-of date unchanged.
